tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming Moscow events by title, date, type or venue. Accepts natural phrases such as "plays this weekend" or "концерты завтра". Always pass lang with the user's language (en, zh or ru) so titles, venue, hall and address come back in that language. Each event has venue (building), hall, addre

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id: title, date and time (Moscow), category, venue, hall, address, description and price range. Pass lang with the user's language.

tools.name: get_seats
tools.description: List seats that are currently free for an event, grouped by section, row and price: each group has the section name, row number, seat numbers (e.g. "1–4, 7"), price and the placeIds in the same order as the seat numbers. Use placeIds with get_widget_link or create_order. Pass lang with the user's la

tools.name: get_widget_link
tools.description: Return a show-stolicy.ru embed link with preselected seats and utm_source. No referral code. Pass lang with the user's language: the page opens in English for en and Chinese for zh.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order with selected seats, name, email, phone, consent and an idempotency key. No email confirmation code. The buyer receives the usual payment email. At most 6 seats, 2 unpaid holds per email, and 5 orders per email per day.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Return status for an order that belongs to the given email.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order_status · Public sink: create_order, get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order_status · Public sink: create_order, get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
